{{Locations|Abandoned Sector|LRSmap=noship|unique=false}}


''An image of some weak and hungry humans comes onto your screen. "Those metal bastards think they can just absorb half of our engines and leave us here to die? I hope you understand the need to take your ship by force."''
*<span style="color:red">3-4 human boarders</span> beam aboard your ship.

==Notes==
This event is called "LANIUS_PIRATE_BOARDERS" in the datafiles.
* If this event happens after a fight against a Lanius ship, the human boarders will have [[Augmentations#Emergency_Respirators|Emergency Respirators]] augmentation. If this event repeats sequentially, the human boarders will still have the augmentation.
